newsitem.title: USA: Burlington Northern grain railcar summary.
newsitem.headline: Burlington Northern grain railcar summary.

text.p: BNSF WILL MAKE AVAILABLE, ON A PERIODIC BASIS, DESCRIPTIVE INFORMATION
CONCERNING ITS GRAIN CAR FLEET, CAR LOADINGS AND OPERATING
PERFORMANCE. THE INFORMATION ON THIS SCORE CARD PERTAINS ONLY TO
BURLINGTON NORTHERN SANTA FE CAR LOADING INFORMATION AT THIS TIME.
THE PERIODS DISPLAYED REPRESENT SUNDAY TO SATURDAY WEEKLY CYCLES.
AVERAGE DAILY C6 FLEET SIZE AND STATUS FOR WEEK ENDING:
C6 CARS STORED SUITABLE FOR GRAIN 4,962 4,369 154 192
C6 CARS STORED NOT SUITABLE FOR GRAIN 0 0 0 0
C6 FLEET PERFORMANCE STATISTICS FOR WEEK ENDING:
AVERAGE EMPTY TIME PER CYCLE (DAYS) N/A 7.8 7.6 7.5
AVERAGE LOADED TIME PER CYCLE (DAYS) N/A 7.7 7.3 8.3
AVERAGE TOTAL TIME PER CYCLE (DAYS) N/A 15.5 14.9 15.8
FLEET VELOCITY TRIPS (4 WEEK AVERAGE) N/A 1.5 1.5 0.9
MONTHLY CAR LOADINGS APRIL MARCH FEBRUARY JANUARY
OUTSTANDING GRAIN CAR DEMAND THROUGH MAY 31, 1997 13,052
(INCLUDES ORDERS AND PROJECTIONS FOR C6, C6X, COTS, UNIT AND SINGLE CAR ORDERS)
COT ACTIVITY - AS OF MAY 15, 1997 UNITS AND SINGLES, (ALL CORRIDORS)
. OFFERED SOLD REMAINING OFFERED SOLD REMAINING
NOTE: BNSF CUSTOMERS DESIRING TO SUBMIT OT-5 REGISTRATIONS SHOULD CONTACT ROGER
SPERRY'S OFFICE AT BURLINGTON NORTHERN SANTA FE, P O BOX 961034, FORT
NOTE: THESE STATISTICS REPRESENT CAR LOADINGS OF 75 GRAIN RELATED COMMODITIES
IN 27 STATES AND 2 CANADIAN PROVINCES. STATISTICAL VARIANCES REFLECT VARIOUS
DATA SOURCES AND SOME NUMBERS MAY BE SUSPECT DUE TO CONSOLIDATION OF BURLINGTON
NORTHERN AND SANTA FE DATABASES UNTIL MID-YEAR 1997.
